question.text: The angle of elevation of a cloud from a point <math><mn>10</mn></math> meters above the surface of a lake is <math><msup><mrow><mn>30</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow></msup></math> and the angle of depression of its reflection from that point is <math><msup><mrow><mn>60</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow></msup></math>. Then the height of the cloud above the lake is

options.text: <math><mn>20 </mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math>

<math><mn>20</mn><msqrt><mn>3 </mn></msqrt><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math>

<math><mfrac><mrow><mn>20</mn><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><msqrt><mn>3 </mn></msqrt></mrow></mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math>

<math><mn>20</mn><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mo>-</mo><mn>1 </mn></mrow></mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math>

solution.text:
Let C be the cloud, D its reflection and PB is the surface of the lake
Then,
PC=PD=H,
QA=H-10cot⁡30o=H+10cot⁡60o
H=10cot⁡30o+cot⁡60ocot⁡30o-cot⁡60o=10sin⁡90o/sin30o=20 meters
